From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Subject: Preflight: closure catalog for QBR readiness (initial asks)

All — kicking off a short preflight to ensure we close high-priority asks ahead of the Sept QBR. Goal: consolidate owners, blockers, and ETA in one tracker by EOD next Thursday.

Context: Acme Analytics (Sasha) is pushing for the Dedicated capacity pricing confirmation and SOC evidence before the board readout. We have a couple of exec asks that need sign-off and a procurement hold that will affect the QBR numbers if unresolved.

Immediate asks (please respond inline):
- Owners: confirm who will own the pricing confirmation to Acme (owner + ETA) — deadline Mon 8/31.
- Security evidence: check SOC artifacts and re-check retention policy wording for Private deploy (owner + ETA).
- Risk exceptions: any exceptions that need exec sign-off (list them).
- Ops: confirm we can include the new throughput numbers in the QBR deck by 9/2.

I attached the preflight-ask-sheet.xlsx and qbr-ask-tracker.csv to this thread. I will consolidate replies and push an updated tracker Friday.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Preflight: closure catalog for QBR readiness (initial asks)

Thanks Marissa — quick notes inline below.

- Owners: Pricing confirmation -> I can own the model variant/pricing confirmation to Acme. ETA: Mon 8/31 EOD. I will confirm available Dedicated pool sizing and estimated unit costs.
- Security evidence: I'll loop in Security (cc'ed via separate ticket) but initial answer: SOC2 summary and retention policy are already in the customer portal; formal evidence package needs ~3 business days to bundle. Owner: Karthik. ETA: Wed 9/2 close of day.
- Risk exceptions: We have one exception request for pre-provisioned burst capacity (35% increase) that needs exec exception. Details below.
- Ops: Throughput numbers — I need raw run numbers from infra. Tentative: can include conservative numbers in the deck; confirm final by 9/2.

On the exception: the customer wants a temporary burst above our guardrails during onboarding. Impact: increases cost estimate and may require SLA carve-out. Recommend we surface to Aditya for exec decision.

-Mark
Karthik Iyer
Director, Serving Runtime
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>

Team — thanks for the quick turn. Summarizing decisions and next steps so execs get a clean brief: please treat this as the single source for owner updates until we close.

Summary (actionable):
- Pricing confirmation (Acme): Owner = Karthik. ETA = 2026-08-31 23:59 PDT. Deliverable: priced quote and Dedicated pool sizing note.
- Security evidence: Owner = Karthik. ETA = 2026-09-02 17:00 PDT. Deliverable: SOC2 summary + retention policy doc bundle (attach to HubSpot).
- Burst capacity exception: Owner = Vivek to surface to Aditya for sign-off. Need a one-paragraph brief by 9/1 noon; include cost delta and proposed guardrails.
- Throughput numbers for deck: Owner = Lauren. ETA = 2026-09-02 12:00 PDT. Deliverable: include conservative P95 latency and sustained tokens/sec for Dedicated.

Please update the qbr-ask-tracker.csv row for Acme with the owner and ETA. I will escalate the burst exception to Aditya this afternoon with the brief attached.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sasha Park <sasha@acme-analytics.com>, procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Procurement hold details from Acme — discount request + next steps

Forwarding procurement note from Acme — short thread below. Procurement is requesting an alternate pricing cadence and an up-front commitment discount; they say the SOC docs are fine but legal needs the retention clause tightened.

----- Forwarded message -----
From: procurement@acme-analytics.com
To: Sasha Park <sasha@acme-analytics.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract questions (retention & discounts)

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the SOC docs — that helps. Two items block us:
1) Retention language: please add a clause specifying logs retained for a minimum of 90 days and a formal deletion confirmation process.
2) Discount: if Redwood will provide a 6-month upfront discount at 12% we can close this quarter. Otherwise procurement will move to next-cycle review.

Procurement Team
Acme Analytics

----- End forwarded message -----

Notes: the retention ask is reasonable, but the discount ask will affect MRR and must be routed through Sales Ops. Per Karthik's burst-exception note, the combined cost changes could materially affect the QBR forecast.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Enterprise Sales Enablement | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 16:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Preflight: closure catalog for QBR readiness (initial asks)

Appreciate the concise summary. Action items from exec:
- Approve retention clause tweak: Legal to draft a one-paragraph addon that ensures 90-day retention and deletion confirmation; Marissa to attach final language to the HubSpot record. ETA: 9/6 EOD.
- Discount ask: Do not promise a 12% blanket across six months without Sales Ops sizing. Lauren -> please open a Sales Ops ticket and propose a structured discount (e.g., usage tier + commitment term). ETA: 9/3 COB for proposal; final decision by 9/7.
- Burst exception: I approve a limited pilot (30 days) with the following guardrails: cap at 35% burst, explicit cost reconciliation at pilot close, and a one-time setup fee to offset provisioning. Karthik — please draft the short brief (one paragraph + cost delta) and send to procurement and Sasha; copy Aditya.

I'll mark this as an exec-level ask and include the approved pilot as a footnote in the QBR deck. Keep updates in qbr-ask-tracker.csv and ping me only for deviations.

- Aditya Rao
COO | Redwood Inference
